blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY — Montenegro Shipping Lines Inc. (MSLI) has opened its online booking system for passenger trips on four routes connecting Batangas City to destinations in Oriental Mindoro, Occidental Mindoro and Romblon. In a travel advisory on Sept. 29, the shipping company announced that passengers can now book tickets online for trips between Batangas City and Calapan City, Abra de Ilog, Puerto Galera and Odiongan. Passengers may reserve tickets through the company’s official website at https://montenegrolines.com.ph/, while walk-in passengers may still purchase tickets at its ticketing counters.
